authoring.author: claude (kinkerstraat odd-faces lane)
authoring.note: Kinkerstraat 65-87 (odd side, to Bilderdijkkade), all 1893. Three gabled fronts (65, 67 stepped; 69 pointed, the left part of BAG pand 69-73), the 6-axis 71-73 front with blocked arches and two dormers, and the narrow row 75-87 (3 axes on 3.3-4.4 m, brick-relief tympana, frieze, pediment dormers, tall shop grounds). Strip 2024-11-29 (low sun).

types.description: Face-local (kinker-65-87 pands 1-2, Kinkerstraat 65 and 67, 1893): plain red-brown brick without speklagen or painted courses, flat heads, iron anchors, 4 upper storeys, a stepped gable with one attic light under a relieving arch. Inline because no library type has it: plain-brick has no gable crown, and the gabled types (neo-renaissance, brick-arched) carry speklagen or painted courses that a placement cannot remove (speklagen needs bands speklagen; bandLines needs bands painted).

limitations: 69-73 is one BAG pand with two fronts of different types (gabled 69, 6-axis 71-73); a placement takes one type, so 69 is the painted-band neck gable instead of its straight-sided pointed gable.
75-87: brick-relief tympana (carved brick fans over the segmental heads) drawn as plain band-brick fills; frieze panels and consoles.
81: pointed Gothic mezzanine lights. 67: round-arched door bay on storey 1. 87: a brick wall dormer.
